risks.risk: Mileage claim is unverifiable and could be rolled back or unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle odometer or engine's ECU mileage readout.

risks.risk: Engine may have been opened/rebuilt with non-OEM parts, affecting longevity.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of valve cover bolts, head gasket seam, and any paint/seal disturbance.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly opened/rebuilt, no premium for 'never opened'

risks.risk: Model/engine code cannot be confirmed, so fitment to buyer's specific car is unverified.

Close-up photo of the engine code/serial number plate or casting mark.
Photo of donor vehicle's odometer or any mileage documentation.
Close-up of valve cover and head bolts to check for signs of prior opening.
Compression test reading or leak-down test result if available.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a generic used car engine assembly with no model/brand readable, and all seller claims about condition, mileage, and origin are unverifiable from the single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unproven/untested used engine.
